Venue: Gate
Headline: Trenches First Launch on Elysium: New User Rewards and Volume Boosts, Share 50,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Trenches now officially supports the Elysium chain, and a launch celebration event is live. During the event, trade Elysium tokens in the Trenches zone to take part in the new user first trade reward, volume boost prize pool and trading leaderboard, with a total prize pool of 50,000 USDT.
You must click "Join Now" to sign up and trade Elysium tokens in the Trenches zone during the event to be eligible for rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 16, 2026, 08:00 – November 26, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event Scope
Elysium tokens in the Trenches zone (combined buy and sell volume). Volume from non-Elysium tokens will not be counted toward this event.
## About Elysium
Elysium is a high-performance Layer 2 in the Hyperliquid ecosystem built by Kinetiq. It settles on HyperEVM, uses HYPE as its native gas token, produces blocks every 100 milliseconds, and is compatible with standard EVM tools.
## Reward 1: New User First Trade Reward, Prize Pool 10,000 USDT
During the event, new users who complete their first Elysium token trade in the Trenches zone with a trading volume of at least 100 USDT will receive a 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Prize pool: 10,000 USDT, first come, first served, while supplies last.
Users with any trading record in the Trenches zone (including the former Gate Alpha zone) before the event starts are not eligible for this reward.
## Reward 2: Trade on Elysium and Share 25,000 USDT with Volume Boosts
During the event, registered users whose actual cumulative trading volume (buy and sell) of Elysium tokens in the Trenches zone reaches 3,000 USDT can share a 25,000 USDT prize pool. The maximum reward per user is 100 USDT.
Existing users receive a boost multiplier based on their cumulative trading volume on other chains (non-Elysium) in the Trenches zone over the past 180 days. The prize pool is shared in proportion to each user's weighted volume, calculated as Elysium trading volume × boost multiplier. Each range includes its lower limit but not its upper limit:
Cumulative Volume on Other Chains, Past 180 Days (USDT) | Boost Multiplier
Below 2,000 | 1.0 (no boost)
2,000 – 5,000 | 1.2
5,000 – 50,000 | 1.3
Above 50,000 | 1.4
Example: User A traded a cumulative 10,000 USDT on other chains over the past 180 days (multiplier 1.3) and has an actual Elysium trading volume of 6,000 USDT during the event, meeting the threshold. User A's weighted volume is 6,000 × 1.3 = 7,800 USDT.
## Reward 3: Elysium Trading Leaderboard, Share 15,000 USDT with 5,000 USDT for Top 1
During the event, users are ranked by cumulative trading volume (buy and sell) of Elysium tokens in the Trenches zone, and the Top 50 share a 15,000 USDT prize pool. First place receives 5,000 USDT, and ranks 2–50 share the remaining 10,000 USDT. Users must also meet the minimum trading volume for their tier to claim the corresponding reward.
Rank | Winners | Reward per User (USDT) | Minimum Volume (USDT)
Top 1 | 1 | 5,000 | 1,600,000
Top 2 | 1 | 1,500 | 500,000
Top 3 | 1 | 1,000 | 340,000
Top 4 – 10 | 7 | 400 | 125,000
Top 11 – 20 | 10 | 200 | 60,000
Top 21 – 50 | 30 | 90 | 30,000
If a user's volume meets the minimum for a higher tier but their rank falls in a lower tier, the reward will be issued according to their actual rank, not the higher tier.
Note: This leaderboard is based on actual Elysium trading volume. The boost multipliers in Reward 2 do not apply.
## Notes
All participants must complete identity verification to claim rewards.
The scope, validity period, and deduction rules of the Fee Rebate Voucher are subject to what is shown on the voucher and in your account. Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred.
The same verified user, linked accounts, and sub-accounts may not participate more than once. Their trading volume will be combined, or they will be disqualified from rewards.
Event page data is for reference only and will be updated within 1–2 hours. Final results are subject to the system's calculation after the event ends.
Rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the event ends. All airdrop rewards will be distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. Reward values shown on the page are estimates for reference only and are subject to token price fluctuations. The actual amount received shall prevail.
Trenches token projects may involve high risk and volatility. Please invest cautiously after fully understanding the risks.
Before trading, please carefully verify the token contract address and confirm that it is on the Elysium chain. Token information is contributed by the community. If any correction is needed, please contact customer support promptly.
Bulk registration of multiple accounts, malicious volume farming, self-trading, wash trading, and other forms of cheating are strictly prohibited. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users and cancel their rewards if such behavior is detected. Multiple accounts under the same verified user will be treated as one account.
In the event of any discrepancy between translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the sole discretion and final right of interpretation for this event, and may modify the relevant terms or cancel the event without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions may not be able to access all or part of the services (including participation in this event, games, or competitions). For details on restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Deposit Rewards Season: Boost Your Deposits and Trades to Share 35,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Deposit Rewards Season is here. Register and make a deposit of any amount for a chance to win 5 USDT. Earn up to 15 USDT with daily net deposit check-ins, and unlock up to 500 USDT by meeting cumulative net deposit and futures trading volume requirements. A total prize pool of 35,000 USDT is up for grabs. Don't miss out.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 16, 2026, 8:00 – November 30, 2026, 8:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Register for a Chance to Win 5 USDT
During the event, users who successfully register and make a deposit of any amount will receive one entry into the lucky draw. After the event ends, 1,000 eligible users will be randomly selected, each receiving 5 USDT.
## Event 2: Daily Net Deposit Check-In to Earn Up to 15 USDT
During the event, users who achieve a daily net deposit of at least $500 will complete that day's check-in. Accumulate the required number of qualifying days to become eligible for the corresponding reward tier.
Each user may receive only the highest reward tier they qualify for. Rewards from different tiers cannot be combined. After the event, users will be ranked by the total number of qualifying days in descending order. Users within the same tier will be ranked by the time they reach the corresponding number of qualifying days. Rewards will be distributed accordingly until the 10,000 USDT prize pool is exhausted.
Note: The daily calculation period runs from 00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC). Both the first and last days of the event count toward qualifying days, with calculations limited to the event period.
Cumulative Qualifying Days | Reward per User
≥ 2 Days | 2 USDT
≥ 6 Days | 6 USDT
≥ 10 Days | 10 USDT
≥ 14 Days | 15 USDT
## Event 3: Meet Deposit and Trading Milestones to Earn Up to 500 USDT
During the event, users who meet the specified cumulative net deposit and futures trading volume requirements will become eligible for the corresponding reward tier.
After the event, a composite score will be calculated based on each user's cumulative net deposit amount (60% weight) and cumulative futures trading volume (40% weight). Rewards within each tier will be distributed in descending order of composite scores. Users who do not receive a reward in their current tier will automatically be considered for the next lower tier they qualify for.
Each user may receive only one reward. The total prize pool is 20,000 USDT, with limited winners per tier, available until fully distributed.
Cumulative Net Deposit | Cumulative Futures Trading Volume | Reward per User | Winner Limit
≥ $5,000 | ≥ $20,000 | 15 USDT | 300
≥ $10,000 | ≥ $50,000 | 30 USDT | 200
≥ $50,000 | ≥ $200,000 | 100 USDT | 50
≥ $100,000 | ≥ $500,000 | 200 USDT | 10
≥ $500,000 | ≥ $1,000,000 | 500 USDT | 5
## Notes
- Participants must click the [Join Now] button on the event page and complete identity verification to be eligible for rewards.
- Trading Volume = Buy Amount + Sell Amount. During the USD1 futures trading pair fee discount promotion, futures trading volume for the relevant promotional pairs will be calculated at 50%. Net Deposit = Total Deposits – Total Withdrawals During the Event. Only on-chain deposits, P2P, and fiat deposits are counted. Internal transfers are not included.
- All event rewards will be distributed as USDT spot tokens to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Any fraudulent actions, including bulk account registration, malicious trading, self-trading, and coordinated trading, are strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts with the same identity information will be considered as one account. Subaccounts are not eligible to participate in the event.
- Market makers, enterprises, institutions are not eligible for this event.
- In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this event.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services (including participation in this event, game, or competition). For details on restricted regions, please read the User Agreement .
